text: Gordon Gallup's mirror (mark) test is designed to provide behavioral evidence for which capacity?
choices: Theory of mind, i.e. attributing beliefs to other agents
Episodic-like memory for the 'what, where, when' of past events
A form of self-recognition or self-awareness
Numerical cognition and the ability to compare set sizes
explanation: An animal that uses a mirror to inspect a dye mark on its own body, rather than treating the reflection as a conspecific, is credited with self-recognition; great apes, dolphins, elephants, and magpies pass. The other options name distinct capacities (mindreading, memory, number) that the mark test is not built to assess.
